description: Offline: resolve the repo's config (presets included, so hidden ignorePaths like `:ignoreModulesAndTests` from config:recommended show up), list the repo's files the way Renovate does (`git ls-files`), and apply Renovate's includePaths → ignorePaths filter. Returns every pattern with the preset or `<own>` config that set it, how many files it matched and a sample; `deadPatterns` (user-owned patterns matching no file, including packageRules[].matchFileNames entries); `substringOnlyHits` (files dropped only because an ignorePaths entry is a substring of the path, e.g. `test` dropping `src/latest/package.json`, with the glob that was probably meant); per-rule matchFileNames counts against the kept files; and a summary. Pass `configContent` to try a config other than the repo's own. Same `externalPresets` / `endpoint` / `platform` opt-ins as resolve_config.

configContent.description: Inline config to evaluate instead of the repo's own config file.

endpoint.description: API base URL that `local>` presets are fetched from (with `platform`) — same semantics as resolve_config.

externalPresets.description: When true, fetch external presets (github>, gitlab>, gitea>, forgejo>) over HTTPS — same as resolve_config. Default false.

maxFiles.description: Cap on the number of listed files evaluated (default 50000); truncation is reported.

platform.description: The platform `local>` presets live on — same semantics as resolve_config (routes only; never moves a token).

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the repository root whose files are evaluated.

name: explain_paths
title: Explain which files Renovate scans
